root_causes.description: Payment service experienced extreme memory usage spike (z=+9.25) causing memory stress that propagated through checkout dependency to frontend, triggering pod restarts as the entry point symptom.

Frontend service exhibited extreme pod restart activity (z>1000, 2 restart events recorded), with pod events showing 'Container frontend definition changed, will be restarted'. Frontend restarts are a downstream symptom of payment memory stress propagating through the dependency chain.

evidence.observed_value: pod_restarts z>1000, 'Killing: Container frontend definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)'

root_causes.description: Checkout service showed high p99 latency (z=-1.06, window=24.85s) as the intermediate dependency between frontend and payment, contributing to frontend errors while root cause originates from payment memory stress.

remediation_steps: Restart payment pods immediately to relieve memory pressure
Investigate and fix memory leak in payment service deployment
Add memory limits/requests for payment Kubernetes deployment
Monitor frontend pods after payment restart to confirm recovery
Review k8s pod definition changes that triggered frontend restarts
